title: ?N?K? EL?KO
category: African Fiction, Children's, Comic Book or Graphic Novel
seller_comments:
When a mystery guest visits Àníké’s school, she has the chance to win a scholarship that will change her fate. Will the help of her friends Oge, Ìlérí and Àríyo the cobbler be enough?
Written by Sandra Joubead and illustrated by Àlàbá Ònájìn, ÀNÍKÉ ELÉKO tells a colourful story
of one girl’s courage in the face of opposition to her dreams.

title: 10 Minutes 38 Seconds in this Strange World
category: Contemporary, Fiction, Historical Fiction, Literature, Novels
seller_comments: A haunting and lyrical novel about Tequila Leila, whose fading memories after death reveal a life of love, pain, and resilience in modern Turkey.

title: 100 Nasty Women of History
category: Feminism, History, Humour, Non-Fiction
seller_comments: Bold, rebellious, and unapologetic—100 Nasty Women of History by Hannah Jewell celebrates fierce women who were too powerful for their time. From warriors to writers, rebels to queens, these are the women history tried to ignore—but who changed the world anyway.

title: 13 Ways of Looking at a Fat Girl
category: Adult, African, Feminism, Fiction, Modernism, Non-Fiction, Psychology, Relationship, Young Adult
seller_comments: 13 Ways of Looking at a Fat Girl by Mona Awad is a sharp, darkly funny novel told through 13 interconnected stories. It follows Lizzie, a young woman struggling with body image, self-worth, and identity as she transforms herself physically—but finds that losing weight doesn’t fix deeper emotional wounds.

category: Books, Classics, Fiction, Satire
seller_comments: 1984 by George Orwell is a dystopian novel published in 1949 that explores themes of totalitarianism, surveillance, and the manipulation of truth. Set in a grim future where the state exercises complete control over every aspect of life, the novel remains a powerful commentary on the dangers of oppressive governments and the loss of individual freedoms.

category: Classics, Dystopia, Fantasy, Fiction, Literature, Politics, Science-Fiction
seller_comments: In a dystopian world ruled by Big Brother, Winston Smith dares to rebel through love and thought—but the Party will stop at nothing to crush dissent.

title: 49 Ways to Get Rid of The Other Woman Without Getting Caught
category: African Fiction, Family, Marriage, Non-Fiction, Psychology, Religion, Self-Help
seller_comments: This book addresses infidelity and the presence of “the other woman” in marriage from the perspective of a wife seeking to reclaim her relationship.

title: 8 Rules of Love : How to Find it, Keep it, and Let it Go
category: Books, New Releases, Non-Fiction, Psychology, Relationship, Romance, Self-Help
seller_comments: Jay Shetty’s 8 Rules of Love: How to Find It, Keep It, and Let It Go offers a refreshing, practical approach to navigating relationships, drawing from ancient Vedic teachings and modern science. A nominee for the Goodreads Choice Award for Readers’ Favorite Nonfiction (2023), the book addresses the full spectrum of the romantic journey—from first dates to heartbreak and renewal.

title: 9 Books Bridgerton Series
category: Historical Fiction, Historical Romance, Romance
seller_comments: But as Daphne waltzes across ballroom after ballroom with Simon, it’s hard to remember that their courtship is a sham. Maybe it’s his devilish smile, certainly it’s the way his eyes seem to burn every time he looks at her . . . but somehow Daphne is falling for the dashing duke . . . for real! And now she must do the impossible and convince the handsome rogue that their clever little scheme deserves a slight alteration, and that nothing makes quite as much sense as falling in love.

title: 99% Mine
category: Adult, Contemporary Romance, Family, Fiction, Friends to lovers, Health, Philosophy, Politics, Romance, Writing
seller_comments: When Darcy’s childhood crush shows up to renovate her house, sparks fly—and she might finally claim the man she’s always loved.

title: A Book Lovers Box
category: Adult, Arts, Nerdy Lifestyle, Non-Fiction
seller_comments: A Book Lover’s Box by Louise Pretzel is a cozy rom-com about a librarian who receives anonymous love notes through her book subscription service — a sweet, literary mystery filled with charm, romance, and bookish delight.

title: A Book Lovers Christmas Jigsaw Puzzle
category: Nerdy Lifestyle
seller_comments:
A Book Lover’s Christmas – 1000-Piece Puzzle
Piece together iconic Christmas scenes from classic literature! Join the March sisters, Father Christmas in Narnia, and Dickensian London in this festive puzzle.
Includes a pull-out poster with quotes and details. A perfect gift for book lovers!

title: A Broken People’s Playlist
category: African Fiction, Historical Fiction, Literary Fiction, Short Stories, Suspense & Thriller
seller_comments: Broken People’s Playlist by Chimeka Garricks is a thought-provoking and compelling novel that explores the complexities of identity, love, and the emotional aftermath of trauma. Set against the backdrop of contemporary Nigerian society, the story follows the lives of a group of individuals who are united by their shared experiences of personal loss and emotional pain. Each character grapples with their own struggles and insecurities, but they find solace and healing in the music that has shaped their lives.

title: A Brush with Love – A Brush with Love, Book 1
category: Adult, Family, Fiction, Friends to lovers, Health, History, Philosophy, Politics, Romance, Science-Fiction, Young Adult
seller_comments: A high-achieving dental student with severe anxiety agrees to a fake friendship with a charming new student, only to find their chemistry is very real.

title: A Certain Hunger
category: Crime, Murder, Satire
seller_comments:
A Certain Hunger by Chelsea G. Summers is a dark, satirical novel that follows the life of Dorothy Daniels, a food critic and unapologetic psychopath with an insatiable appetite—for both food and murder. The novel offers a unique and twisted perspective on the connections between desire, consumption, and control.
Dorothy is no ordinary food writer. She’s intelligent, sophisticated, and accomplished, but beneath her refined persona lies a violent, obsessive nature.

title: A Christmas Carol
category: Classics, Fantasy, Fiction, Literary Fiction
seller_comments: With its memorable cast of characters such as Scrooge, Bob Cratchit, Tiny Tim and the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Yet to Come, Charles Dickens’s A Christmas Carol is the most heart-warming of seasonal tales, a timeless classic that continues to enchant readers around the world and a lesson in charity and hopefulness that is as powerful today as when it was first written in 1843.

title: A City of Flames – A City of Flames, Book 1
category: Adult, Crime, Dark Romance, Enemies to lovers, Fiction, Literature, Memoir, Mystery, Philosophy, Politics, Science-Fiction, Thriller, Young Adult
seller_comments: A City of Flames (A City of Flames, Book 1) by Rina VasquezNara joins dragon-slayers to avenge her father’s death—but the fire dragon she’s sworn to kill may hold secrets that change everything.

title: A Conspiracy of Ravens
category: Action and Adventure, Thriller
seller_comments: Othuke Ominiabohs’ second book, A Conspiracy of Ravens is a deftly woven tale of love and hate, patriots and traitors, and of heros and villains . . . A tour de force.

title: A court of thorns and roses box set 5 books
category: Adult Fiction, Best sellers, Books, Books in boxes, Booksets, Fantasy
seller_comments: A Court of Thorns and Roses Paperback Box Set by Sarah J. Maas includes all five books from the bestselling fantasy series, offering readers a journey through romance, danger, and intrigue in the world of the Fae. This set is a must-have for fans of epic fantasy and captivating storytelling.

title: A Cowrie of Hope
category: African Fiction, Books, Classics
seller_comments: But when Nasula finds herself unable to pay for Sula’s education, her hopes seem to have been extinguished – until a friend advised her to go to Lusaka and sell her last sack of highly sought-after Mbala beans. Nasula makes the journey, but in the city she finds herself exposed to new, and predatory, dangers.

title: A Crane Among Wolves
category: Fantasy, Fiction, Historical Romance, Romance, Science-Fiction
seller_comments: A Crane Among Wolves by June Hur is a gripping young adult historical novel set in 1506 during Korea’s Joseon dynasty. The story follows seventeen-year-old Iseul, who embarks on a perilous journey to rescue her sister, Suyeon, from the clutches of the tyrannical King Yeonsan.

title: A Cupboard Full of Coats
category: Adult Fiction, Contemporary, Fiction, Literary Fiction, Literature, Mystery
seller_comments: A Cupboard Full of Coats by Yvvette Edwards explores themes of trauma, guilt, and reconciliation within a complex mother-daughter relationship. Set in East London, the story centers on Jinx, who has spent fourteen years grappling with guilt over her mother’s murder.

title: A Curse Carved in Bone, TPB
category: Adult, Biography, Crime, Enemies to lovers, Fantasy, Fiction, Literary Fiction, Magic, Mystery, Romance, Science-Fiction, Thriller
seller_comments: A Curse Carved in Bone by Danielle L. Jensen — A dark fantasy romance where a mortal’s bargain with a cursed immortal ignites a dangerous tale of love and betrayal.

title: A Curse of Salt
category: Adult, Comic Book or Graphic Novel, Fiction, Historical Fiction, Literary Fiction, Romance, Romantasy, Science-Fiction, Thriller
seller_comments: A Curse of Salt by Sarah Street is a romantic YA fantasy where Ria sacrifices herself to a cursed sea king to save her family—only to uncover secrets, magic, and unexpected love.
